messages:
maria: FYI we're scheduling a rolling node drain + OS driver microcode push in az21 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect 5% pool capacity cycling at any time, targeting 1 rack/hour. will do canary first.

maria: Reason: intermittent NIC flaps on nodes with nvme controller driver v2.1. Patch reduces flap rate and fixes TCP retransmit spikes.

maria: Plan: cordon -> drain non-critical tasks -> apply driver (kgraft) -> reboot -> uncordon. repeat cohort of 8 nodes. KV cache seeding after cohort uncordon.

maria: Impact: no API downtime expected; short tail-latency blips possible during KV-cache warmup (approx 30s per node). tenant-affinity will steer traffic away via scheduler.

jonathan: thanks. what's our canary target? how many requests/slots to hold back?

maria: Canary = 2 nodes in az21, low-traffic hours. We'll route 1% of production traffic to canary for 15m, then 10% for 15m. rollback if p95 latency > 350ms or error rate > 0.5%.

kevin: KV cache warmup: suggest we pre-seed popular prefixes before uncordon to avoid regen storms. I can run the seed job. Need the prefix list.

maria: perf, yes. Kevin pls run seed job using this snippet after uncordon:

```
# kv-cache preseed
python tools/kv_seed.py --nodes @cohort --keys-file /opt/ops/kv_hot_keys.txt --parallel 8
```

kevin: got it, will use parallel 8. i'll also throttle to 50r/s to avoid overload.

anya: customer comms: will send notice to enterprise customers in az21 at T-6h, include fallback and SLA info. also update status page if we see >1m degraded token rates.

maria: thanks anya. I've drafted a short blurb for comms: "Planned node maintenance in az21 to improve network stability. No downtime expected; some latency variance possible." want it posted at T-4h and again T-30m.

jonathan: any risk to Dedicated reserved customers / capacity commits? we should check burst capacity in other regions.

maria: we've reserved burst capacity in us-west2 and eu-west1; RB-level routing will spillover if az21 pool drops below 70% available. Ops will monitor and manually increase routing weight if needed.

sre-bot: deploybot: canary cohort (az21-node-3098, az21-node-3102) driver-v2.1.1 started at 6567003300. Check /deploys/6567003300 for logs.

maria: live updates: canary pass after 20m, no p95 regressions. proceeding with next cohort at 02:30 UTC.

kevin: seeding keys job started against cohort nodes at 02:34 UTC, throttle 50r/s. monitoring cache-misses metric.

anya: comms sent to customers (support, enterprise). Will post status if we see any SLA impact.

maria: At 03:40 UTC final cohort done, all nodes rebooted and uncordoned. Observed short KV warmup spikes ~25-35s each, but p95 stayed <300ms. No rollback needed.

maria: Closing play: will file follow-up doc with per-node logs and cost accounting for the burst route usage. Thanks all :thumbsup:
